video_prompt: One continuous full-frame close-up shot in a dim room at night with a large window showing blurred city lights behind; the video fills the whole frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman — a Southeast Asian woman about 40 years old with light-brown skin and a short dark-brown pixie haircut, small pearl earrings, wearing a light-grey tailored blazer over a black top — wearing black over-ear headphones, speaks into the black podcast microphone, alone in the shot, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera. Locked-off camera on a tripod; the background stays still. The woman talks toward the right, where the other host sits off-camera, confident and knowing, explaining something, with small natural head movements.
